info.description:
bank is one person's archive: messages (mail, chats, AI conversations), a media
library with what was watched, listened to and read, files, published notes, and a
catalogue of the files on disks that come and go, below /v1/disk.

GET /v1/search searches all of it at once; kind narrows the search to one kind of
record. Every record is cited by one ref, kind:value: msg:<16 hex> for a message,
content:<16 to 64 hex> for bytes, and the ID for a library record, such as
item:<32 hex>. GET /v1/refs/{ref} says what any of them names.

A token reads, or reads and writes. An operation that changes the archive names the
write role in its security requirement, and answers Forbidden to a read token.

Lists and searches take limit, 100 by default and at most 500, and those that page by
position take offset, at most 10000. Every failure is JSON with a _tag.

Each kind ranks its own matches, and the hits are merged by reciprocal rank fusion into one list; limit and offset page that list. A file is one hit with its places, whether it is attached to messages, kept in the library or on a disk. tags.description:
The catalogue of files on disks that come and go. For every file it records
where it is (an entry: a path on a volume), what it is (a content, identified by its
BLAKE3 digest and cited as content:<hex>), and the text, tags, OCR and image descriptions
read from it. It keeps no file bytes, and the server is not the machine the disks attach
to: bank disk get on that machine copies a file.

A place is missing when the last scan of its folder no longer found the file, and has
version "previous" when the entry held this content before its bytes changed, so earlier
versions of a file stay findable.

Cite a file by its content ref; entry IDs name a location in this catalogue only.
